shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: a buildable sky level above and a solid rock basement below, fully simulated as linked pocket maps with see-through open air and cross-level pawn AI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level, you see the live surface below through open air; (2) performance via caching, incremental grids, and async pure-data work.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column (basement / surface / sky), enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Support rule: upper-level cells are walkable/buildable only where the map below has a roof (snapshot at gen; live roof-change sync lands in T1). No roof below = impassable open air with no affordances.
- Floor-above = roof-below sync arrives in T1 (constructed-class roof written under upper floors).
- Basement always generates as 100% solid mineable rock matching the surface tile's natural rock types (deterministic via NaturalRockTypesIn), fully fogged, thick rock roofed (engine isUnderground), vanilla roof-collapse mechanics intact so players must leave support pillars.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches (ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, logistics, roofSync); log once, shut subsystem down, fail open. HarmonyBoot patches each class independently.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (as built, end of T0)
- LevelComp (MapComponent, every map): level int, upperMap / lowerMap / groundMap refs, MapByLevel dict on the ground map (column controller). Scribed with references; invalid maps cleaned on load.
- LevelExtensions: ConditionalWeakTable-cached accessors, allocation free.
- LevelMapGen: pocket-map creation mirroring vanilla PocketMapUtility exactly, plus parent.Tile = sourceMap.Tile (vanilla skips this; we need a valid tile so the sky level gets real day/night and the basement gets the surface's rock types). Static Context wires level + groundMap into the new map's LevelComp during generation.
- Map generators: AB_Basement (isUnderground, biome AB_Underground from Core's Biome_Underground parent, temp 12, GenStep_ABSolidRock: per-rock Perlin argmax fill + rough terrain + full fog) and AB_Sky (biome AB_OpenSky, temp 10, GenStep_ABSkyTerrain: ground roof snapshot -> open air / rock surface above natural roofs / rooftop terrain above constructed roofs).
- Terrains: AB_OpenAir (impassable, no affordances, avoidWander) and AB_RoofSurface (standable, Light/Medium/Heavy affordances). Rock surface above mountains reuses the rock's own naturalTerrain.
- Stairs: AB_StairsDown / AB_StairsUp (stuffable, Structure category, PlaceWorker enforces surface-only placement for now + level cap). On completion a stairwell generates/reuses the level map and spawns its counterpart def at the same coordinates (basement: 3x3 rock cleared + unfogged; sky: 3x3 air converted to rooftop). Counterparts skip generation because their link is pre-set. Destroying either end removes both (open question: keep on violent destruction?). Float menu: Go up/down the stairs (reasons inline when unavailable), gizmo: View level above/below.
- JobDriver_UseStairs: walk to stairs, 90 tick climb with progress bar, despawn/respawn at counterpart, drafted state preserved, guarded recovery respawns the pawn at the source stairs if transfer throws.
- View switching: PageUp/PageDown hotkeys + stairs gizmo, camera position and zoom preserved (LevelCamera).

## Quadruple pass log (2026-07-18)
Fixed: stale counterpart reference now dropped when destroyed. Deferred: map-removal cleanup hook (T4), stairs placement from non-surface levels (T2), cascade-destroy on violent kill kept as design choice. Perf: zero recurring cost (no ticks, no per-frame work beyond hotkey check).

## Tranche plan
- T0 DONE: registry, generators, stairs, hotkeys, all compiling green; awaiting first in-game smoke test.
- T1: visuals: see-below SectionLayer on the sky map, no-bleed pass, live floor-to-roof and roof-to-terrain sync, support-rule floors.
- T2: movement: stair graph, cross-level pathing, drafted moves, pawns auto-use stairs for jobs, non-surface stair placement.
- T3: logistics: hauling, storage, bills across levels.
- T4: systems: temperature/weather sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling.

## Status
T0 code complete (0 warnings), repo pushed. Smoke test pending.
